summary.compact_footer: The v2 below-fold footer finding is resolved in these v3 compact captures: all localized Language/Settings labels and full controls are visible with bottom margin, including Japanese.
summary.logo: No top clipping in any inspected capture. Complete artwork visually observed in 25 captures; one Mac large dark tool-display impression is uncertain, with original pixel content corroborated and identical to v2.
summary.cjk: Korean, Simplified Chinese and Japanese glyphs readable in both themes. Japanese two-line examples caption remains readable without overlapping the project button.
summary.style: Existing palette, button shapes, iconography, menu order and caption appearance remain visibly consistent. Compact layout has tighter vertical arrangement and smaller logo; Japanese logo is smaller than other compact locales.
summary.large_unchanged: All eight Arch large originals and both requested Mac Japanese large originals have identical SHA256 to their v2 counterparts.
summary.frame_integrity: No blank/corrupt whole frames or observed text clipping.

runtime_claims_not_inferred_from_images.coordinator_provided: Arch16 cases plus 6 regressions and Mac16 cases passed native/footer/keyboard checks with zero errors.
